data:
This course will enable prospective chemistry majors to be in
touch with their basics, and also help those who are
undecided on their majors. The topics covered here are those
that will help the chemistry majors to prepare for the later
courses in the chemistry curriculum.  This course will introduce basic concepts of
electronic structure and periodic properties, Chemical bonding, the behavior of gases, and basic thermodynamics.
We will also talk about acid-base chemistry and chemical
equilibrium. Then we will discuss about structure of basic
organic molecules and some organic reactions. Finally, we will
introduce the concept of light-matter interaction.
